baseline_observations: index-START.html was missing localStorage retrieval and list population logic.
Without deterministic fixture initialization, browser tests suffered from state leakage or reliance on ambient browser storage.
External icon requests (https://fav.farm/) introduced potential flakiness in isolated offline test harnesses.
decision: Implement complete client-side storage persistence in index-START.html. In tests/course/r57-t015.mjs, use explicit local storage fixtures across two fresh browser contexts to assert identical deterministic DOM state, stub external assets, and test form submission and checkbox toggling.
